pre_command: osascript -e 'tell application "Pages" to quit without saving' && osascript -e 'tell application "Numbers" to quit without saving' && osascript -e 'tell application "Keynote" to quit without saving' && osascript -e 'tell application "Keynote" to activate'
instruction: Help me create an empty slide with an aspect ratio of 4:3.
evaluator: osascript -e 'tell application "Keynote" to set slideWidth to width of document 1' -e 'tell application "Keynote" to set slideHeight to height of document 1' -e 'slideWidth / slideHeight * 9' | grep -q "12" && echo "True" || echo "False"
